functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sync_class_session_randomizers()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  update public.randomizer_sessions set session_date=new.session_date,
    status=case when new.status='completed' then 'completed' else status end,
    completed_at=case when new.status='completed' then coalesce(completed_at,new.completed_at,now()) else completed_at end
    where owner_id=new.owner_id and course_id=new.course_id and class_session_id=new.id;
  return new;
end;
$function$

functions.name: valid_randomizer_fact_marks
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.valid_randomizer_fact_marks(marks jsonb)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
  select case when jsonb_typeof(marks) = 'object' then
    not exists (
      select 1 from jsonb_each(marks) as item(key, value)
      where key not in ('F', 'A', 'C', 'T')
        or value not in ('0'::jsonb, '1'::jsonb, '2'::jsonb, '3'::jsonb, '4'::jsonb, '"na"'::jsonb, '"insufficient"'::jsonb)
    )
  else false end;
$function$

constraints.definition: CHECK (((source <> 'manual_adjustment'::text) OR ((textbook_id IS NULL) AND (lesson_id IS NULL) AND (lesson_label IS NULL))))

constraints.name: randomizer_attempts_completion_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((outcome = 'pending'::text) AND (completed_at IS NULL)) OR ((outcome <> 'pending'::text) AND (completed_at IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: randomizer_attempts_fact_complete_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((fact_marks IS NULL) OR (assessment_status <> ALL (ARRAY['observed'::text, 'scored'::text])) OR (fact_marks ?& ARRAY['F'::text, 'A'::text, 'C'::text, 'T'::text])))

constraints.name: randomizer_attempts_fact_marks_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((fact_marks IS NULL) AND (fact_version IS NULL)) OR ((fact_marks IS NOT NULL) AND (fact_version IS NOT NULL) AND (fact_version = '1.0'::text) AND valid_randomizer_fact_marks(fact_marks))))

constraints.name: randomizer_attempts_observation_required_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((assessment_status <> 'observed'::text) OR ((score IS NULL) AND (((performance_level IS NOT NULL) AND (observation_version IS NOT NULL)) OR ((fact_marks IS NOT NULL) AND (fact_version IS NOT NULL) AND (fact_marks ?& ARRAY['F'::text, 'A'::text, 'C'::text, 'T'::text]))))))

constraints.name: randomizer_attempts_outcome_status_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((outcome = 'answered'::text) AND (assessment_status = ANY (ARRAY['scored'::text, 'observed'::text, 'pending'::text]))) OR ((outcome = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'not_answered'::text, 'undone'::text])) AND (assessment_status = 'not_applicable'::text))))

constraints.name: randomizer_attempts_owner_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (owner_id) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: randomizer_attempts_response_outcome_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((outcome = 'answered'::text) AND (response_status = ANY (ARRAY['answered'::text, 'partial'::text, 'peer_supported'::text]))) OR ((outcome = 'not_answered'::text) AND (response_status = 'no_response'::text)) OR ((outcome = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'undone'::text])) AND (response_status = 'unobserved'::text))))

constraints.name: randomizer_attempts_scores_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((assessment_status = 'scored'::text) AND (task_completion IS NOT NULL) AND (comprehensibility IS NOT NULL) AND (language_control_vocabulary IS NOT NULL) AND (content_interaction IS NOT NULL) AND (total_score IS NOT NULL)) OR ((assessment_status <> 'scored'::text) AND (task_completion IS NULL) AND (comprehensibility IS NULL) AND (language_control_vocabulary IS NULL) AND (content_interaction IS NULL) AND (total_score IS NULL))))

constraints.name: randomizer_sessions_completion_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((status = 'in_progress'::text) AND (completed_at IS NULL)) OR ((status = 'completed'::text) AND (completed_at IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: randomizer_sessions_owner_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (owner_id) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: student_notes_body_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((char_length(TRIM(BOTH FROM body)) >= 1) AND (char_length(TRIM(BOTH FROM body)) <= 2000)))

constraints.name: student_notes_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((supersedes_id IS NULL) OR ((char_length(TRIM(BOTH FROM correction_reason)) >= 1) AND (char_length(TRIM(BOTH FROM correction_reason)) <= 500))))

constraints.name: student_notes_check1
constraints.definition: CHECK (((supersedes_id IS NULL) OR (correction_reason IS NOT NULL)))
